ACCESS: https://www.barkerandstonehouse.co.uk/robots.txt fetched FIRST via probe.fetch (HTTP 200, profile safari17_0). It contains FOUR groups - Googlebot, Googlebot-image, AdsBot-Google and '*' - and names NO anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web or Claude user-agent, and carries no Crawl-delay and no Content-Signal line. Every group disallows the same short list: /_=_, /basket, /checkout, /checkout/login, /checkout/success, /account, /search. I requested none of those - no internal-search URL and no account/basket path. Declared sitemaps: /sitemap.xml and /sitemap-image.xml. Transport was plain curl_cffi with fingerprint rotation; no WAF, no 403, no proxy needed, exactly as the prior Furniture pass on this SR recorded.

TREE - THREE INDEPENDENT SOURCES, ALL AGREEING THERE IS NO BATHROOM:
(1) MAGENTO GRAPHQL, the site's own complete category tree. POST https://mage.barkerandstonehouse.co.uk/index.php/graphql with categories(filters:{}, pageSize:1000){items{id name url_path path level product_count}} returned HTTP 200 and total_count=481 - all 481 category nodes the storefront publishes, with their parent paths. I rebuilt the full tree from the 'path' field and grepped every node name and url_path for bath|bathroom|shower|basin|sink|toilet|tap|vanit|wash|wc|sanitar|mirror|towel. The ONLY hits were the five mirror nodes listed in `review` - accessories/mirrors, accessories/mirrors/wall-mirrors, accessories/mirrors/full-length-mirrors, accessories/mirrors/dressing-table-mirrors and brands/timothy-oulton/home-furnishings/mirrors. There is NO node whose name or url_path contains 'bath', 'shower', 'basin', 'toilet', 'tap', 'sanitary' or 'vanity unit' anywhere in the 481. The 38 level-2 departments are, in full: Accessories, All Accessories, Beds, Bedroom Furniture, Bestsellers, Black Friday, Brands, Chairs, Christmas Gift Ideas, Clearance, Cool Bedroom Picks, Dining Room Furniture, English Heritage, Footstools, For Christmas, Garden Furniture, Hallway Furniture, Headboards, Home Office Essentials, In Time for Christmas, Interior Trends, Living Room Furniture, Mattresses, Need It Quick, New In, Office Furniture, Online Exclusives, Fabric Samples, Shop the look, Sofas, Storage, Store Clearance, Sustainable Collection, Sustainable Dining, Tables, The Art of Collecting, Trees4Trees, UGC, Vicky. No Bathroom, no Bath, no Sanitaryware, no Bathroom Furniture, no Bathroom Accessories.
(2) ROOM NAVIGATION. Barker's room-based nodes cover exactly three rooms - Living Room Furniture (494), Bedroom Furniture (364) and Dining Room Furniture (137), plus their colour/material re-cuts (White/Grey/Black/Oak/Wooden Bedroom and Living Room Furniture) and the seasonal Clearance/New In/Need It Quick room re-cuts. There is no Bathroom room node at any level.
(3) MEGA-MENU + SITEMAP. The homepage was fetched live (HTTP 200, 700,205 bytes, profile safari17_2_ios); its server-rendered mega-menu yields 303 absolute category links and the only bath/shower/mirror-family hits are the four mirror URLs above. https://www.barkerandstonehouse.co.uk/sitemap.xml was fetched in full (HTTP 200, 6,445,898 bytes, 6,680 <loc> entries covering categories AND every PDP). Grepping all 6,680 for bath|shower|basin|toilet|tap|vanit|sanitar|towel|washstand returns SEVEN URLs and every one is a false positive on a substring: /storage/lutyen-dresser-toilette-with-3-drawers-large (a chest of drawers - 'dresser toilette'), /accessories/natural-wood-tapered-floor-lamp and /accessories/natural-wood-tapered-table-lamp and two Nelda chair variants ('tapered' contains 'tap'), and /storage/zerina-vanity-table-82x57x64cm (a dressing table). Not one bathroom product and not one bathroom category exists on the site.

QTY: none recorded - there is no Bathroom leaf to count, so no quantity was taken and none was estimated.

DEDUP: lib/dedup.already_extracted() was run on all four mirror URLs (the only candidate leaves the site offers) and returned None for each, so nothing here was suppressed by the cross-file index; the mirrors are excluded on classification grounds (see `review`), not on dedup grounds. Consistent with this, the prior Furniture pass on this SR recorded 67 furniture rows and no bathroom furniture, and its ledger note lists no bathroom node either.

CONCLUSION: Barker and Stonehouse is a furniture and home-accessories retailer that sells no sanitaryware, no baths, no showers, no enclosures, no basins, no toilets, no bathroom taps, no bathroom vanity units, no bathroom storage, no bathroom mirrors and no bathroom accessories. Status NO BATHROOM FOUND with rows: [] is the correct result, established from the site's own 481-node Magento category tree, its rendered mega-menu and its complete 6,680-URL sitemap.

review.issue: INSPECTED UNDER RULE 10 AND DELIBERATELY NOT RECORDED - these are decorative mirrors, not bathroom mirrors. Barker and Stonehouse's ONLY mirror nodes are Accessories > Mirrors (product_count 20) and its three children Wall Mirrors (18), Full Length Mirrors (3) and Dressing Table Mirrors (3), plus a 2-product Brands > Timothy Oulton > Home Furnishings > Mirrors node. The parent sits in the Accessories department between Art, Clocks, Vases, Candle Holders, Rugs and Decorative Objects - a wall-decor hierarchy with no bathroom, vanity-unit, LED, illuminated, backlit, demister, anti-fog, heated, shaving, magnifying or mirror-cabinet framing anywhere, and the site has no Bathroom department for them to belong to. I enumerated the node's own grid through the storefront's Searchspring endpoint (siteId zzw53h, filter.category_hierarchy=Accessories>Mirrors) and every product is a decorative gallery, wall, round or floor mirror: Cecile Gallery Mirror, Hewn Mirror 180x80x5cm, Wooden Asymmetrical Mirror, Sylvan Mirror, Tosca Wall Mirror, Set of Two Tear Drop Mirrors, Zerina Mirror, Black Round Mirror, Large Gold Asymmetrical Mirror, Calista Gallery Mirror, Round Brown Glass Mirror, Valla Dressing Table Mirror, Inception Round Medium Mirror, Casimir Mirror, Redondo Mirror Brushed Brass, Mirror Scalamance, Times Mirror Clock, Hawaii Wall Mirror, Emerald Wall Mounted Mirror, Oriana Mirror, Tondo Round Mirror, Frozen Tall Mirror 220cm, Inception Tall Mirror 139x240cm, Inception Round Large Mirror. Not one bathroom mirror. By PRIMARY TYPE + FUNCTION + HIERARCHY (rules 2, 11, 29) this is Decor/Wall Decor, not Bathroom. lib/dedup.already_extracted() returns None on all four mirror URLs, so this is a genuine judgement call and not a dedup exclusion - logged here so the rule-10 inspection is auditable.
